Oct 19, 2017, 32:O1:05 PM

Good morning Deborah
now sending along to you the summary information with respect to the Carol S. Chomsky Non-Exempt
Marital Trust and the Carol S. Chomsky Exempt Marital Trust. Please let me note a few aspects, as
follows:
1. As you'll see, there is a one page summary for each of the trusts which shows, year by year, sources of
income and items of expense, as well as distributions made to or on behalf of Noam. We have broken out
income into the categories we thought most likely to be of use and have likewise broken out expenses
among typical categories.
2. The third sheet that I've attached aggregates the income and expense information for both trusts and
provides a Trust Accounting Income analysis, with comparison of that income to actual distributions for
each year.
I hope you II find that these reports give you, Noam and Valero the information that you're looking for,
but I'll be standing by to answer questions, of course. If you wish I can also provide you with copies of the
underlying account statements, bearing In mind that those run to several thousand pages.
As I mentioned in our exchanges yesterday, I'll be out of the office through October 30. On my return
anticipate being called as a witness in a trial, but the trial schedule is still up in the air, so my availability
during the week of the 3Oth may be spotty. Please bear with me.
Thanks,
Max

A. Max Kohlenberg
Howland Evangelista Kohlenberg Burnett, LLP
